accepted.title: DeepCrossAttention: Supercharging Transformer Residual Connections
accepted.scope: Implemented: text-formula GRN-v3, three independent routes, first/middle-sum/last-k history, small multi-head causal attention and actual autograd. History contains original input and incremental outputs, not repeatedly accumulated residual states. Limited history preserves intermediate outputs in an unweighted sum bucket rather than dropping them. Full FFN/outer-residual wiring, LM training, checkpoint retrofit, KV caching and benchmark gains are absent. Nonzero-w gradient checks use explicit parameter interventions, not a claim that dynamic routing was learned from zero initialization.
accepted.cost_basis: Section5 uses width512, four-times-wider FFNs, sequence128 and batch2048 over64 TPUs for500k steps, totaling131B tokens, plus6–42-layer, C4-scale and ImageNet sweeps. This clearly exceeds one A100/A30 or Mac. No model/data download or trial training is attempted. Only a2×5-token,8-wide,4-source core is budgeted below30seconds across three seeds (estimate). The advertised CUDA path requires this batch's independent real-A100/A30 receipt.

accepted.title: The KL Divergence Is Never Negative, Except in PyTorch
sections_read: fixed upstream Exponential source and README
accepted.scope: Only positive, matching-shape FP32 CPU rates, a17-term phi series, far-range branches and first-order analytic autograd are implemented. Nonfinite/nonpositive inputs, unsupported dtype/shape/device, ratio overflow/underflow and nonfinite outputs are rejected; extreme-range mantissa/exponent handling is not claimed. An independent80-digit Decimal reference uses actual stored FP32 values to check near equality, branch boundaries, far values, gradients and exact identity. It is not interval certification. All18 families, FP16/BF16, strict correct rounding, F.kl_div, logits repair and distillation are absent.
accepted.cost_basis: The author repository lists a10.8GB frozen benchmark, CPU hours per configuration and a cluster for all53. Downstream work includes ten-seed large-vocabulary distillation and Qwen2.5-1.5B/GPT-2 quantization/circuit studies with additional downloads. Appendix C.4 reports overhead of unfused reference operators; a tiny core is not full-package throughput. Full experiments are too expensive and not attempted. No10.8GB data or models are downloaded. Only32 nearby scalars and small formula tests are budgeted below10seconds across three seeds (estimate), CPU-only with CUDA rejected.
